market_name: Will 11 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the 11-cut probability move is corroborated by moves in nearer-strike cut markets (1-4 cuts) and by SOFR/fed funds futures; isolate whether it is idiosyncratic thin-market noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT and 2Y/10Y yield direction; confirm bonds are actually rallying rather than the market being a stale low-liquidity print.
time_plan.2h: Look for any macro catalyst (jobs data, Fed speak, risk-off headline) that would justify a genuine recession-easing repricing.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether the implied-probability shift held or reverted; a reversion implies noise and the thesis should be dropped.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate cumulative TLT move vs baseline; mark whether the leak/signal had any predictive value for duration.

predictions.reasoning: An 11-cut-in-2026 market pricing in ~275bps of easing is a deep-recession/emergency-easing tail scenario. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive Fed easing, which pushes front-end and long-end yields lower and long-duration Treasury prices higher. TLT is the most liquid direct proxy for that duration bet.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check VIX and equity futures for a coincident risk-off move; determine if equities are reacting to the same driver.
time_plan.1h: Distinguish 'bad news = recession' selloff from 'Fed put' rally; watch cyclicals vs defensives.
time_plan.2h: Confirm whether any real catalyst underlies the shift versus thin-market noise.
time_plan.6h: Reassess direction; if no coherent risk-off/on signal, treat as non-signal.
time_plan.12h: Mark realized SPY move against baseline and record low predictive value.

predictions.reasoning: Extreme easing expectations are ambiguous for equities: 11 cuts implies severe economic distress (bearish for earnings/risk) but also aggressive Fed support (bullish for multiples). The net direction is genuinely uncertain over 12h, so the mapping is weak. Most likely a risk-off recession read dominates initially, but conviction is low.

evidence_used: Market strike of 11 cuts (~275bps) in 2026 is a far-tail scenario implying recession or emergency easing
Standard macro linkage: aggressive Fed easing expectations lower yields (bonds up), weaken USD, support gold
Polymarket rate-cut-count markets are typically thin and noisy, especially at extreme strikes
uncertainty_notes: An 11-cut strike is a very low-probability tail; small notional flows can move implied probability without any real information
12h window is far too short for a 2026-resolution macro market to reliably transmit to asset prices
No headline or catalyst is given; the move could be pure liquidity noise
Equity direction is genuinely ambiguous (recession fear vs Fed-put support)

llm_justification.summary: The market prices an extreme tail (11 25bp cuts / ~275bps of easing in 2026), so a sharp rise in its implied probability would signal recession/emergency-easing expectations. The cleanest asset read is long-duration Treasuries higher (TLT up) as yields fall; equities are directionally ambiguous. Both mappings are weak over a 12h window because the market is thin, far-dated, and lacks a stated catalyst, so confidence is low and neither move approaches the 700bp tradable threshold.
key_assumptions: A probability shift in this market reflects genuine easing/recession expectations rather than thin-market noise
Bond yields fall and duration rallies when aggressive-easing odds rise
The 2026-resolution horizon still allows some near-term asset transmission
failure_modes: The implied-probability move is thin-market noise and reverts within hours, producing no asset move
Any macro information is already public and priced, so no leak/edge exists
TLT is only a modest proxy for a 2026 easing path and may be dominated by unrelated rate/supply dynamics
Equity direction flips (Fed-put rally) opposite to a recession read
12h window too short for a far-dated macro market to move liquid assets at all
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
